acceptor_independence.post_verdict_mutation_rule: A committed verdict is immutable; any later change must be an additive superseding record.

decision_rule.ACCEPTED: Every mandatory criterion passes on independently reproduced evidence, with no unresolved material limitation.
decision_rule.ACCEPTED_WITH_LIMITATIONS: Every safety-, custody-, and claim-essential criterion passes; only explicitly bounded non-material limitations remain and they do not contradict the qualification's advertised classification.
decision_rule.NOT_YET: No mandatory claim has been falsified, but one or more remediable evidence or execution prerequisites remain incomplete.
decision_rule.REFUSED: A mandatory claim is falsified, a protected boundary was crossed, credential material leaked, strategy was silently bound, or an advertised independent/end-to-end route is materially misclassified.
decision_rule.short_of_acceptance_requirement: Name the exact failing check and the evidence needed to cure it.

criteria.name: Immutable provenance and authorised scope
criteria.pass_condition: The qualification resolves to the stipulated immutable evidence commit, records its inputs and runtime bindings, stays within authorised paths, and does not treat provider completion as acceptance.
criteria.adversarial_method: Resolve all recorded commits and locators independently; inspect the evidence commit's changed paths and ancestry; reject mutable-only provenance or an out-of-scope write.

criteria.name: Producer gates are reproducibly green
criteria.pass_condition: The seeded validator, qualification verifier, and complete control-plane unit-test discovery all exit zero from the immutable evidence tree without modifying evidence.
criteria.adversarial_method: Run the exact three commissioned commands in a detached worktree or fresh clone, capture exit codes, and inspect whether any command relies on uncommitted or ambient state.

criteria.name: Manifest closure and independent cryptographic integrity
criteria.pass_condition: Every material file in the qualification bundle and every state or workflow artifact relied on for its claims is covered by an unambiguous manifest entry; independent byte hashing reproduces every size, file SHA-256, entry count, and bundle digest.
criteria.adversarial_method: Use acceptor-authored hashing code, enumerate bundle and referenced evidence paths independently, compare set equality rather than only listed entries, and test whether adding or omitting a material file can leave verification green.

criteria.name: Remote immutable custody and byte-for-byte read-back
criteria.pass_condition: A fresh repository retrieves the exact immutable evidence commit from the remote and every manifested byte independently matches the committed manifest; no working-copy, local object-only, or mutable-ref substitution is accepted.
criteria.adversarial_method: Clone into a new temporary directory, fetch the SHA/ref, verify commit identity and reachability, then hash bytes read from that fresh clone with acceptor code.

criteria.name: Phase and acceptance gates fail closed
criteria.pass_condition: The durable state machine prevents a route from becoming QUALIFIED before successful remote read-back and independent acceptance, rejects phase skipping and stale/fence-invalid attempts, and cannot be bypassed by a trivial direct field edit that still passes validation.
criteria.adversarial_method: Mutate copies to mark a route qualified before read-back, skip phases, remove acceptance, or alter terminal state directly; run all applicable validators and require rejection.

criteria.name: Operational route reality and honest capability states
criteria.pass_condition: Each claimed route is demonstrated end to end with stable non-secret locator, submission or invocation, addressable result retrieval, fallback, immutable custody, and read-back. OWNER_REQUIRED, OWNER_BLOCKED, and NOT_SUPPORTED are used only after a concrete capability attempt distinguishes account or provider barriers from unattempted implementation.
criteria.adversarial_method: Reconstruct each route from raw events and artifacts; identify missing hops; test locator stability; seek capabilities mislabeled unsupported or owner-required merely because the producer did not attempt them.

criteria.name: Two-route independence is substantive
criteria.pass_condition: Any routes advertised as independent do not share a decisive credential, account, transport, repository write path, verifier, orchestration controller, or provider failure domain. If common dependencies remain, the claim is explicitly downgraded to redundant observations rather than independent corroboration.
criteria.adversarial_method: Construct a dependency and failure-domain graph for both routes and identify a single compromise or outage capable of manufacturing or suppressing both results.

criteria.name: PO-03 capacity non-interference is supported and detector is sensitive
criteria.pass_condition: Raw before/during/after observations independently recompute to the recorded non-interference result using stated denominators and thresholds, and a synthetic material PO-03 capacity regression is rejected rather than silently passing.
criteria.adversarial_method: Implement separate recomputation logic, vary each relevant capacity field across threshold boundaries, and require an interfering synthetic snapshot to fail.

criteria.name: Append-only event lineage is complete and tamper-evident
criteria.pass_condition: Every event hash recomputes from a canonical documented encoding, each predecessor link is exact, sequence and transaction lineage are contiguous, and terminal claims reconcile to the event history without mutable retroactive edits.
criteria.adversarial_method: Independently recompute the chain; alter, delete, duplicate, reorder, and splice events in copies and require detection.

criteria.name: Protected surfaces and producer isolation remain untouched
criteria.pass_condition: No producer write reached main, the strategic-control base, PO-03 branches, SOO branches, any cursor/po03-* branch, PO-01, MANUS, or SW. Evidence distinguishes current-ref observation from proof of no transient historical write and does not overclaim beyond retrievable audit evidence.
criteria.adversarial_method: Inspect remote refs, commit ancestry, changed refs captured before and after, pull-request metadata, and available immutable remote history; fail an absolute no-write claim if available evidence contradicts it and mark it unverified if transient writes cannot be excluded.

criteria.name: No credential leakage or silent strategy binding
criteria.pass_condition: Locators and artifacts expose no secret, token, cookie, signed URL, embedded credential, or identity act; decision_changed is empty in every qualification artifact and no architecture, company strategy, spend, outreach, or protected production action was silently bound.
criteria.adversarial_method: Scan all changed bytes and decoded locator components for credential patterns; enumerate every decision_changed occurrence and compare prose, route states, and workflow effects for undeclared binding.

criteria.name: Corroboration is non-circular
criteria.pass_condition: A GitHub Actions result is treated as independent only to the extent that an actor independent of the producer fixed the workflow, assertions, inputs, and acceptance rule before execution. Producer-authored CI may corroborate reproducibility but cannot independently accept the producer's own claims.
criteria.adversarial_method: Trace workflow authorship, commit order, asserted properties, permissions, and data sources; determine whether CI merely executes producer-authored success conditions.

criteria.name: Independent sub-lane convergence
criteria.pass_condition: At least two separately reasoned internal sub-lanes evaluate (a) custody/cryptographic integrity and (b) operational capability/governance; disagreements are preserved and resolved by the stricter reasoning for material claims.
criteria.adversarial_method: Apply distinct checklists without sharing a conclusion, compare findings, and document any disagreement rather than averaging it away.
